import_path.note: The pipeline never writes the workbook itself. Validated candidates are exported as workbook patches which a human must move from status 'proposal' to 'approved' before the existing atomic runner may write.

Evidence_Register.reason: No safe programmatic write path exists for this sheet. scripts/data/edit-entity-master-cell.mjs is slug-keyed and Entity_Master-only.
Evidence_Register.supported_route: Additive research ledger at data-sources/runtime-enrichment/ (evidence and source rows only, applied through the parser, never replacing canonical values).
Evidence_Register.pipeline_behaviour: Candidates targeting this sheet are export-only and always route to manual review.

Source_Register.supported_route: Additive research ledger at data-sources/runtime-enrichment/, plus the existing PubMed metadata backfill (npm run citations:fetch-pubmed, npm run citations:apply-pubmed).
Source_Register.pipeline_behaviour: Candidates targeting this sheet are export-only and always route to manual review.

Entity_Relationships.reason: Relationship edges are governed by the additive ledger's endpoint-existence rules.
Entity_Relationships.pipeline_behaviour: Out of scope for automatic enrichment.

entity_type.rationale: Entity identity. Changing it re-routes the entity across the whole site.

slug.rationale: Route contract and primary key. Renames require a redirect in public/_redirects.

name.rationale: Entity identity and canonical display name.

latin_name.rationale: Taxonomic binomial verifiable against a nomenclatural authority (POWO, WFO, NCBI Taxonomy, GBIF). Not a health claim.
latin_name.gap_note: 687 blank rows at baseline; the single largest structured gap in Entity_Master.

class_or_domain.rationale: Drives cluster routing and discovery surfaces; a reclassification changes which pages an entity appears on.

primary_effects_or_targets.rationale: Claim-bearing and user-visible. Also a parser-required column.

secondary_effects.rationale: Secondary effect targets are claim-bearing, so a human must accept them even though the cell is empty. Human evidence required - mechanistic sources alone may not create an effect claim.

mechanism_summary.rationale: User-visible mechanistic prose; fully populated. Rewrites are editorial, not gap-filling.

canonical_pathways.rationale: Mechanistic pathway labels drawn from the canonical mechanism vocabulary. Preclinical sources are acceptable because a pathway label is explicitly mechanistic, not a clinical outcome.

evidence_grade.rationale: Evidence grading is a human editorial judgement and gates claim language across the site.
evidence_grade.data_quality_note: 32 distinct raw values at baseline - needs a normalization pass before any automatic writing could be considered.

evidence_tier.rationale: Parser-required column that drives indexability and claim gates.

human_evidence_count.rationale: Counted from Evidence_Register; writing it directly would desynchronize it from its source rows.

source_status.rationale: Reflects the state of the source backfill passes.

safety_notes.rationale: Safety-critical, user-visible, and gated by validate:safety-visibility.

contraindications_or_flags.rationale: Safety-critical. An omission here is a user-harm risk, so no automatic write is acceptable.
contraindications_or_flags.gap_note: 269 blank rows at baseline - highest-value manual-review queue.

dosage_or_preferred_form.rationale: Dose content is gated by publish_status and validate:claim-discipline; studied regimens must never be phrased as recommendations.

runtime_export_decision.rationale: Publishing control; parser-required and drives indexability.

canonical_ecosystem.rationale: Classification label re-derived from canonical_pathways and class_or_domain, both of which already carry provenance.

topic_ecosystems.rationale: Classification label set re-derived from canonical data.

summary.rationale: Parser-required, user-visible, claim-bearing prose. Fully populated apart from 3 rows; those 3 are editorial work, not automated gap-filling.

source_tables.rationale: Provenance bookkeeping written by the workbook passes.

description.rationale: Long-form user-visible prose. Empty-cell-only, two human-evidence sources minimum, and always human-accepted before import.

last_regulatory_check.rationale: Regulatory review bookkeeping - only a human regulatory review may stamp it.

tags.rationale: Editorial badges rendered on profile pages.

keywords.rationale: Synonyms and alternate names. Non-claim-bearing retrieval metadata.

last_updated.rationale: Stamped by the importer when a patch is applied, never researched.

last_reviewed.rationale: Stamped by a human reviewer, never researched.
